_meta.source: Hand-authored for this repo (2026-08-08) from the author's own scenario specification -- the fifth evaluation scenario, one of the two the abstract previously listed as planned. Not transcribed from an external assignment or authoritative report; same provenance caveat as smart_home and family_location.
_meta.purpose: A K-12 grades portal: students submit assignments and view their own grades, parents view their child's grades, teachers review and grade, an admin manages accounts, and the whole application plus its databases run on a third-party cloud hosting provider. Minors' education records at a third-party processor is the privacy core. All flows Process-mediated so every interaction is reachable with no mapping-table caveats.

flows.description: Student logs in and submits an assignment (work file, student id, course, submission timestamp)
Portal routes the submission and grading requests to the assignment & grading service (student id, course, file reference, requesting role)
Grading service stores the submitted assignment file with student id, course, and submission time
Teacher logs in and requests the queue of submissions to review for their courses
Portal displays student submissions to the teacher (student names, work content, submission times)
Teacher records a grade and written feedback for a student's assignment (grade, feedback text, student id, grader id)
Grading service writes the grade record (student id, course, grade, feedback, grader id, timestamp)
Student requests their own grades and feedback
Portal displays the student's own grades and teacher feedback to the student
Parent logs in and requests their child's grades (parent account linked to child account)
Portal displays the child's grades, feedback, and submission history to the parent
Administrator creates, modifies, and disables accounts and parent-child links (names, emails, roles, relationships)
Grading service writes account records and parent-child relationship links to the account directory
Nightly database backup and hosting replication ships full grade records, assignments, and account directory to the third-party cloud hosting provider
Grading service reads grade records to build student, parent, and teacher views
